name: whale-check
//price: Placeholder $0.05/call — TUNE THIS. Rationale in x402/README.md. Marginal cost of the cached-snapshot design is ~$0 (reads SQLite, no per-call RPC/inference), so any positive price clears cost. $0.05 also keeps firehose polling far above the Telegram sub (e.g. polling every 3 min for a week ≈ 3,360 calls ≈ $168 vs the $10 week sub), so it does not cannibalize the sub. If you later switch to live-fetch-any-wallet (per-call RPC/inference), re-check price > that new marginal cost.
//freeTier: First 1,000 req/month at 0% platform fee, 5% after (per Bankr pricing). This is Bankr's cut, not the caller's price — confirm current numbers in the docs.
//schema: JSON-Schema describing inputs (query params) and output. Confirm the exact wrapper key/shape the config expects.

target.description: A Hyperliquid wallet address (0x…40 hex) OR a coin/market symbol (e.g. HYPE). NOTE: the scoring engine is Hyperliquid-native — see the chain caveat in x402/README.md.

chain.description: Echoed through; the engine scores Hyperliquid data regardless. See README caveat.

healthScore.description: 0–100 current-state wallet health (or notional-weighted whale health for a coin).

confluence.description: Combined smart-score (skill) of the aligned whales.

whaleCount.description: Number of tracked whales aligned on the dominant coin+side.
